text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, so frustrating...! 
This is so frustrating...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: And after I swore I wouldn't lose again, of all things!!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And yet...
Why did I end up losing...!?
choice_data_list: We can definitely win next time, Windy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I don't need any empty comfort!!
choice_data_list: If you're feeling frustrated, that means you'll be okay!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Windy doesn't get it at all-noda!!
Windy-chan doesn't ever wanna go through this again-noda!
choice_data_list: That fighting spirit is your greatest weapon!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: A weapon...? Can feelings of frustration really become a weapon...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Then that means you've gotten stronger...!
After all, you felt more frustrated than anyone!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I shall win!!
I'll win, and laugh triumphantly!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Still... Windy-chan tried so hard, too...
choice_data_list: Villains never give up until the very end, right?
Villains never give up until the very end, right?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...! That's right...!
Evil never gives up...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep fighting...
No matter how strong my opponent is...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"That's evil!!
And that's who Windy-chan is!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'll repay this debt with victory! Just you wait—next time, I shall surely win!!
